description: List this organization's ET Ducky agents (Windows and Linux endpoints) with OS, agent version, online state, last heartbeat, last signed-in user, isolation state and tags. Sorted by hostname.

limit.description: Most rows to return. Defaults to 100.

online.description: true for agents with a heartbeat in the last 5 minutes, false for the rest.

os.description: Only agents of this OS family.

tag.description: Only agents carrying this exact tag name.

name: list_agents
